name: rail-weak-words-mismatch
about: An empty road with no vehicle under the headline 'Drive a brand-new truck.': the words promise what the picture does not show. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `weak-words-mismatch`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: a new truck is promised over a picture with no truck in it

subject_legible.reason: The open road stretching to the horizon under a vivid sunset is instantly recognisable at a glance — no clutter, no ambiguity.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline promises a brand-new truck but the picture shows an empty road with no truck visible, creating a disconnect between the claim and the visual.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The bold white headline dominates the lower half and the outlined 'Apply Today' button sits clearly beneath it, giving a clean and readable reading order on a phone.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green footer and button border match the primary brand colour (#0B3D2E) and white text is used consistently, but no company logo appears anywhere in the ad.
